subject: general
question:
Select the correct combination of letters that when sequentially filled in the blanks of the given series will make the series logically complete.

B_FH_LNP_T_X
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: B_FH_LNP_T_X

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) DIQU → B__D__FH / __I__LNP / __Q__T__U__X

Option 2)** ****DJRV**** **→ B__**D**__FH / __**J**__LNP / __**R**__T__**V**__X

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a803be079e60f032ba51940477f5ad391595c7670738332015f8dde655894261.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b56cbdcfd0986da40f7a708e150b76603a8e8075eeb4c3fb48517cf0743ccc3.png] 

Option 3) CKSU → B__C__FH / __K__LNP / __S__T__U__X

Option 4) CIQW → B__C__FH / __I__LNP / __Q__T__W__X

Hence, the correct answer is "DJRV".
